instruction: GUI-only requirement: Launch Revit from the Revit shortcut or the provided application launch, then complete the task entirely in the Revit graphical user interface. Do not open Command Prompt, PowerShell, Terminal, Dynamo, pyRevit, macros, external API automation, Python, or any helper script/code that directly generates or edits the deliverable file. Use only Revit native GUI tools, menus, dialogs, model views, properties, families already available in the project, and built-in IFC export commands. Seed structural frame. Open the provided seed IFC from C:\Users\user\Desktop\init.ifc in Revit before editing. Convert it into a one-storey framed room with an overall footprint about 12 m by 8 m. Create one room named Frame Room, one floor slab, four walls, at least one door, four columns, and four beams near the top of the walls. The provided seed IFC is an editable starting reference; keep useful geometry, but it is acceptable to redraw simple walls, floors, rooms, doors, windows, roofs, stairs, columns, beams, or curtain walls with native Revit GUI tools if that is faster. Create real Revit model elements rather than visual-only detail lines or placeholder geometry. Use the Revit Room tool for named rooms so they export as IFC spaces. Save the only required deliverable on the Desktop as C:\Users\user\Desktop\result.ifc using Revit's built-in IFC export. Use IFC4 or IFC2x3 if the export dialog asks for a setup, and enable room or space export if that option is available. The exported IFC should contain IfcSpace rooms named Frame Room; at least 1 building storeys, at least 4 wall elements, at least 1 slabs, at least 1 doors, at least 4 columns, at least 4 beams; no IfcBuildingElementProxy entities. The overall model extents should be about 12 m by 8 m horizontally and about 3.5 m tall, with ordinary Revit modeling tolerance. Other dimensions, exact coordinates, materials, family type names, wall thicknesses, relationship nesting, and harmless metadata may vary.
